# Funny Station Rules
Rules only exist so I have something to cite when punishing bad actors. If you just play responsibly, you shouldn't have to read these! Go have fun, soldier. Keep in mind AHELPing serves a different purpose here, as a tool to request things.
## Rules
### 1.) No bigoted or sexual content of any kind will be tolerated. - You WILL be banned for this. I don't do appeals. Depending on severity it might be reported to Funky Station administration.
### 2.) Don't be a dick out of character. - You can play the asshole character you love. You can not harass people in OOC once you're shoved out an airlock.
### 3.) Don't destroy things for the sake of destruction. - The station shouldn't explode just because one person wanted to destroy it for fun.
